item.title: Fireplace Upgrades in a Strata: What Approvals Are Needed?
item.description: Swapping a fireplace in a strata unit usually needs more than a contractor's quote. Here's the approval path under BC's Strata Property Act and the gas rules, and what councils should ask for before work starts.

item.title: How to Handle an Owner Who Won't Allow Fireplace Inspection
item.description: When an owner refuses access for a fireplace or vent inspection, here's how BC strata councils can use notice, bylaws, fines and the CRT fairly.
